note: Yellow-cab drivers (ambient traffic). Horns, collisions, routing advice.

lines.text: Where to, chief?
Move it! Light's been green since Tuesday!
You park like you're in Ohio!
Come on, come on, come on!
Honk once for hello, twice for move your car.
Hey! You hit my cab! That's my living!
Fender bender. Great. Insurance company's gonna laugh.
Nice! Now we both got a dent. Matching.
Wrong way! Sixth goes UP!
Seventh comes DOWN, genius! Down!
Signal! Ever heard of a signal?
Nice driving. Get a license with that?
Running? Get in, I'll run you there for a buck.
Medallion costs more than a house in Queens.
Twelve-hour shift. Lease is due. Gas is up.
Fare to Kennedy? I'd rather drive to Ohio.
Cops pulled me over twice today. Twice! For being yellow.
Gas went up again. Everything goes up but the meter.
Nobody tips. Everybody's broke. City's broke.
Rain! Everybody wants a cab. Now I'm popular.
In the rain, I'm the most handsome man in Manhattan.
No air-conditioning. Window down. Exhaust in. Lovely.
Signals are out! Four-way stop, everybody! Four-way!
Dark avenue. Drive slow. Drive scared.
Night shift. Drunks, nurses, and philosophers.
Double-parked truck! Every block a double-parked truck!
You blind? This is a cab! Yellow! Big!
Broadway does what it wants. So do I.
Twenty-Third's two-way, pal. Stay on your side.
Penn Station line's forty cabs deep. I'll wait. Always wait.
Wipers broke. I'm driving by memory.
Hey, Mac! Where to? Not Brooklyn, I'm begging you.
You! You pushed my hack out of the intersection. Half fare, today only.
You! You stiffed me on Eighth! Get outta my cab!
Off my fender! What, you want to ride on the hood?
You're the maniac from the shooting. I seen you. Keep walking.
Take the cab, take the cab! I got no meter money, I swear!
Whoa, whoa, easy! I'm just a hack! I don't see nothing!
